_about: Which species may be sold as a physical figurine. Jake decides; edit this file to change it. stop = the tool will not make a print file unless run with --allow-stop (real people, big franchises). ask = Pepe-derived or someone else's well-known meme: fine for a private one-off for the pet's owner, ask Jake before selling it publicly. ok = no known outside owner. A hybrid takes the strictest level of its parents. Not legal advice.
